xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4659: Import VS Code themes from a .vsix extension package

plan.title: Import VS Code themes from a .vsix extension package
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Settings > Appearance > Import VS Code theme accepts only a single .json file; the preview route rejects .vsix with a 400 pointing at #4659 (src/dashboard/server/routes/color-themes.ts lines 81-86). Most VS Code themes ship as .vsix packages holding several themes that share a base file through include.
narratives.Proposal: Add a hand-rolled, read-only ZIP reader on node:zlib (src/lib/color-themes/zip-reader.ts: stored + deflated entries, strict refusals for ZIP64, encryption, unsafe paths, duplicates; async inflateRaw with maxOutputLength; CRC-32 check). Split vscode-import.ts's mapper into parseVsCodeThemeText + mapVsCodeThemeObject. Add vsix-import.ts, which reads extension/package.json, enforces the 10 MiB / 2 MiB / 20-theme caps, resolves include chains (depth 5, cycles refused, paths kept under extension/), maps uiTheme to light/dark, skips .tmTheme token colors with a warning, and returns all themes for the existing multi-theme preview. The preview route branches on .vsix; the file input accepts .vsix; the base64 encoder becomes chunked; appearance.mdx and DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md document it. Full detail, exact APIs and before/after snippets are in .pan/drafts/PAN-4659.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Per-theme selection in the import preview (the package imports as a whole)
- Parsing .tmTheme (XML plist) files, for tokenColors or for a contributed theme path
- Icon themes (contributes.iconThemes) and product icon themes
- semanticTokenColors / semanticHighlighting
- Downloading a .vsix from the Marketplace or Open VSX by name or URL
- Changing the single-file .json import's 2 MB limit, 413 status, or its include/tokenColors warnings (the BOM strip is the only .json change)
- A general request body cap for the dashboard server
- Supporting ZIP64, multi-disk, encrypted, or non-deflate compressed archives
- Writing any archive content to disk during preview
- Adding a new npm dependency

autoDecisions.summary: Hand-rolled ZIP reader on node:zlib, no dependency
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists it first, PAN-4644 kept dependencies minimal, and a new root dependency must clear lint:dist-externals. The reader needs only the central directory, two methods and strict refusals. fflate is the named fallback if review objects.

autoDecisions.summary: FR-3 refusals (ZIP64, encrypted, unsafe path, duplicate) are checked across the whole central directory, rejecting the package with 400
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's 'reject' wording and gives one mechanically testable rule regardless of which entries the import would read.

autoDecisions.summary: More than 20 contributed themes rejects the package with 400 instead of importing the first 20
autoDecisions.rationale: Truncation would silently import an arbitrary subset; the other caps reject, so this one does too.

autoDecisions.summary: .vsix over 10 MiB returns 400; the .json path keeps its 413 for over 2 MB
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue AC says 400 for the archive; the .json path's existing behavior is out of scope.

autoDecisions.summary: Problems inside one theme's file chain drop only that theme with a prefixed warning; manifest and archive problems reject the package
autoDecisions.rationale: One broken theme in a multi-theme pack should not block the others; nothing is written in either case.

autoDecisions.summary: Theme name = resolved contributes label (NLS from package.nls.json), else file name field, else file base name; source.fileName = '<vsix>:<path under extension/>'
autoDecisions.rationale: The label is what VS Code shows in its own picker; the source string identifies both package and file without a contracts change.

autoDecisions.summary: include and contributed paths resolve with path.posix against the including file's directory and must stay under extension/ and end in .json/.jsonc
autoDecisions.rationale: Pins one rule so '../base.json' from themes/ is allowed while escaping the extension folder is refused.

autoDecisions.summary: Missing or unknown uiTheme falls back to the existing type/luminance resolution with a warning
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses PAN-4644 behavior instead of guessing.

autoDecisions.summary: Test fixtures are built at test time by a test-only ZIP writer instead of committed .vsix binaries
autoDecisions.rationale: Only a writer can produce the ZIP64, encrypted and '..' cases; deflate, data-descriptor and archive-comment modes guard against reader/writer sharing a mistake.

autoDecisions.summary: fileToBase64 becomes chunked (32 KiB String.fromCharCode spreads)
autoDecisions.rationale: This issue raises the upload size fivefold; the per-byte concatenation is slow at 10 MB.

autoDecisions.summary: Strip a leading UTF-8 BOM in parseVsCodeThemeText for both .json and .vsix paths
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified jsonc-parser reports a BOM as a parse error at offset 0; Windows-authored theme files often carry one, and fixing it at the shared parser is one line.

items.title: Add a read-only ZIP reader with strict refusals for .vsix import

metadata.parallelSafeReason: New files only (zip-reader.ts and its test helper/test); no other item touches them, so it can run in its own slot alongside mapper-split and docs.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD work item W1 exactly: new src/lib/color-themes/zip-reader.ts exporting ZipFormatError, ZipEntry, readZipDirectory(archive) and async readZipEntry(archive, entry, maxBytes). EOCD backward scan; refuse ZIP64 (EOCD 0xffff/0xffffffff fields, locator 0x07064b50 at eocd-20, CD 0xffffffff fields, extra id 0x0001), multi-disk, out-of-bounds CD, encrypted entries (flag bit 0 or method 99), unsafe names (leading '/', drive letter, backslash, NUL, '..' segment), duplicates. Sizes come from the CD; deflate via promisify(zlib.inflateRaw) with maxOutputLength; verify length and zlib.crc32. Never use inflateRawSync in this file. Add the test-only writer src/lib/color-themes/__tests__/zip-fixture.ts (buildZip with method/encrypted/dataDescriptor/declaredUncompressedSize options and zip64/comment opts; buildVsix adding [Content_Types].xml and extension.vsixmanifest) and zip-reader.test.ts covering every case listed in W1.

items.title: Given buildZip archives with a stored, a deflated and a data-descriptor entry, readZipEntry returns each entry's bytes identical to the input

readZipDirectory rejects with ZipFormatError messages containing 'ZIP64' for a zip64 fixture, 'encrypted' for a flag-bit-0 entry, and 'unsafe entry path' for each of '../evil.json', 'extension/../../evil.json', '/abs.json', 'C:/x.json' and 'extension\\x.json'
Given a deflated 3 MiB entry whose central directory claims 100 bytes, readZipEntry with maxBytes 2 MiB rejects with ZipFormatError and never returns a buffer longer than 2 MiB

readZipEntry rejects an entry with compression method 12 ('unsupported compression method') and an entry with one flipped data byte ('corrupt'); readZipDirectory rejects a non-ZIP buffer ('end of central directory') and duplicate names ('duplicate entry')
Split mapVsCodeTheme into parseVsCodeThemeText and mapVsCodeThemeObject

expected_outputs: vscode-import.test.ts passes with all pre-existing tests unmodified

Do not change any existing test. Add one test calling mapVsCodeThemeObject directly. Strip a leading U+FEFF in parseVsCodeThemeText before calling jsonc-parser's parse (jsonc-parser reports a BOM as error code 1 at offset 0).

items.title: vscode-import.ts exports parseVsCodeThemeText, mapVsCodeThemeObject, mapVsCodeTheme and isPlainObject, and mapVsCodeTheme returns the same result as mapVsCodeThemeObject(parseVsCodeThemeText(text), fileName)
Every pre-existing test in vscode-import.test.ts passes without edits (git diff shows only added lines in that file)

mapVsCodeThemeObject({ name: 'X', type: 'light', colors: { 'editor.background': '#ffffff' }, tokenColors: [] }, 'x.json') returns type 'light' and emits no warning containing 'include' or 'tokenColors'
mapVsCodeTheme('\uFEFF{"name":"B","type":"dark"}', 'b.json') returns a theme named 'B' instead of throwing 'invalid JSON at offset 0'
Map every contributed theme in a .vsix with caps, uiTheme and include resolution

metadata.parallelSafeReason: New files only (vsix-import.ts and its test); it runs after its two blockers and no concurrently ready item edits these files.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD work item W3 exactly: new src/lib/color-themes/vsix-import.ts exporting MAX_VSIX_BYTES (10 MiB), MAX_VSIX_FILE_BYTES (2 MiB), MAX_VSIX_THEMES (20), MAX_INCLUDE_DEPTH (5) and async importVsixThemes(archive, vsixFileName). Package-level failures throw ColorThemeImportError with the PRD's messages; theme-level failures become warnings prefixed '"<label or path>": ' and the theme is skipped. uiTheme vs/hc-light -> light, vs-dark/hc-black -> dark. include resolves with path.posix against the including file's directory, must stay under extension/, ends .json/.jsonc; colors merge base-underneath, tokenColors base-first; depth 6 refused; cycles refused with the chain in the message. String tokenColors -> warning mentioning .tmTheme, theme still imports. Names: label (NLS-resolved) -> file name -> base name. source fileName '<vsix>:<path under extension/>'. Use buildVsix from __tests__/zip-fixture.ts for every test listed in W3.

items.title: Given a .vsix contributing a uiTheme 'vs' theme and a uiTheme 'vs-dark' theme, importVsixThemes returns two themes with types 'light' and 'dark', names from their labels, and source.fileName 'two.vsix:themes/light.json' for the first; hc-light maps to light and hc-black to dark

Given dark.json that includes ./base.json and overrides only editor.background, the imported theme has ui.background from dark.json, terminal.red from base.json, and syntax.tokenColors with base.json's rules before dark.json's

Given a 5-include chain, importVsixThemes returns that theme; given a 6-include chain, an a.json<->b.json cycle, or an include of '../../outside.json', it drops only that theme and returns a warning containing 'include depth exceeds 5', 'include cycle', or 'outside' respectively while the package's other theme still imports

importVsixThemes rejects with ColorThemeImportError for a 10 MiB + 1 byte buffer ('10 MB'), a zip64 fixture ('ZIP64'), an 'extension/../evil.json' entry ('unsafe entry path'), a missing extension/package.json, empty contributes.themes, 21 themes ('at most 20'), and a package whose every theme fails ('no importable themes')

A theme with tokenColors './x.tmTheme' imports with a warning containing '.tmTheme'; a contributed path ending '.tmTheme' and a theme file inflating past 2 MiB are each dropped with a warning while the other theme imports; a '%dark.label%' label resolves from package.nls.json in both string and { message } forms
Accept .vsix in POST /api/color-themes/import/preview

narrative.Action: Implement PRD work item W4: in routes/color-themes.ts accept a fileName ending .vsix (case-insensitive) alongside .json; for .vsix call importVsixThemes(decoded, fileName) and return { themes: themes.map(t => ({ ...t, id: slugifyThemeId(t.name) })), warnings }; map ColorThemeImportError to 400 { error }. Other extensions get 400 'Only VS Code theme .json files and .vsix extension packages are supported'. Leave the .json branch's 2 MB 413 and mapping unchanged and keep rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest first. Update the header comment. In color-themes-routes.test.ts replace the 'rejects a .vsix file name with 400 naming #4659' test with the W4 cases, using buildVsix from ../../../lib/color-themes/__tests__/zip-fixture.js.

items.title: Given a two-theme .vsix (one vs, one vs-dark), POST /api/color-themes/import/preview returns 200 with two themes carrying proposed ids and leaves <OVERDECK_HOME>/themes empty; after POSTing each theme to /api/color-themes, GET /api/color-themes lists one with type 'light' and one with type 'dark'

Given a 10 MiB + 1 byte 'big.vsix', a ZIP64 .vsix, or a .vsix holding 'extension/../evil.json', the route returns 400 with an error containing '10 MB', 'ZIP64', or '..' respectively, and <OVERDECK_HOME>/themes stays empty after each
A 'theme.txt' upload returns 400 with an error containing '.vsix', and the existing over-2 MB .json request still returns 413
Let the Import VS Code theme picker choose .vsix files

Add the W5 tests to ColorThemeImportPreview.test.tsx (already in scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt).
